sentences.text:
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Manas Ranchhor Khatri
For Respondent(s) :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Prakash Sharma
Order 01/03/2019

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the license was issued to the petitioner under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 for the hotel situated at Plot No.7 Hotel Complexes, Jodhpur, Road Jaisalmer in the name of M/s. Brys Hotels Pvt. Ltd./ Premendra Singh Rajawat, who is their representative.

The name of the hotel is M/s. Brys Fort, Jaisalmer which is one of the units of M/s. Brys Hotels Pvt. Ltd. and is now known with the name of M/s. Domont Developers Pvt. Ltd. (petition) in terms of MOU.
However, the license remains for the same hotel and there was no occasion (2 of 2) [CW-2990/2019] to cancel the license after the details were informed to the respondents.
Issue notice of writ petition as well as stay application.
In the meanwhile, the effect and operation of the order dated 04.02.2019 issued by the CMHO, Jaisalmer canceling the license on the basis of the ownership is stayed.
